content: 1. Administer 0.075 mg of the medication orally at the same time every day without any interruptions between pill packs. For guidance on missed pills and the use of backup contraceptive methods, refer to the administration instructions. This medication is not intended for emergency contraception (e.g., morning-after pill) and should not be used to prevent pregnancy after unprotected intercourse, as it is ineffective in such cases. It does not provide protection against HIV/AIDS or other sexually transmitted diseases (STDs); condoms should be used to prevent STDs. 2. Apalutamide reduces the effectiveness of norgestrel by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Contraceptive failure may occur due to decreased serum concentrations of norgestrel. Patients should use an alternative or backup contraceptive method during co-administration and continue backup contraception for 28 days after discontinuing the strong CYP3A4 inducer to ensure contraceptive reliability. 3. Advise patients to use an alternative or backup contraceptive method during co-administration and for 28 days after stopping the strong CYP3A4 inducer. 4.
